 Meanwhile, here's an update from Indore
 Prasanna pings: Yash Dhull follows up his unbeaten 78 off 40 balls against Punjab with his maiden T20 hundred, off just 52 deliveries, against Bihar at the Daly College in Indore.
 Navigates a tricky morning wicket and anchors Delhi’s innings. After going unsold at the IPL 2026 auction, he’s sparing no effort this time!
